sites.functional_impact_measured: Anti-FLAG immunofluorescence confirmed both total and cell-surface expression of the FLAG-tagged MRGPRF construct in transfected cells. No MRGPRF-specific functional (signalling) assay was reported.
sites.rationale: MRGPRF is a GPCR with no endogenous signal peptide; the extracellular N-terminus (residues 1–48, 48 residues before TM1 at position 49) is the only extracellular terminus available for a surface tag. The PRESTO-TANGO construct places FLAG between the cleaved exogenous signal and M1, confirmed at the cell surface by anti-FLAG immunofluorescence. Python lookup confirms seq[0]='M', consistent with residue_after='M'. The 48-residue extracellular N-terminal span provides ample steric room for a short epitope tag. PRESTO-TANGO system (Kroeze et al. 2015, PMC4424118): an exogenous cleavable signal sequence followed by a FLAG epitope tag was appended to the N-terminus of full-length MRGPRF (and 319 other GPCRs) to enable surface-expression monitoring. MRGPRF has no endogenous signal peptide (topology is extracellular from residue 1); after cleavage of the exogenous signal, FLAG sits at the extracellular N-terminus, i.e. before residue M1. No specific residue number is named in the paper, but the N-terminus is the only extracellular terminus of this 7-TM receptor, so the junction is uniquely determined as insert_after_residue=0.

sources.claim: At the 5′-end, we included a cleavable signal sequence to promote membrane localization 23 and a FLAG epitope tag in order to be able to monitor cell surface expression by immunohistochemistry.
( E ) Mouse MrgF cDNA was inserted into the pEGFP-C1 vector to creat the pEGFP-MrgF fusion plasmid, which was transfected into NIH3T3 cells alongside the empty vector.

literature_notes: Both ledger entries (L1/L2 and L3/L4) converge on the same junction: the extracellular N-terminus of MRGPRF (insert_after_residue=0, before M1). L1/L2 is the primary evidence (human MRGPRF, FLAG tag, surface expression confirmed by anti-FLAG immunofluorescence in the PRESTO-TANGO system). L3/L4 is independent corroborating evidence from the mouse ortholog MrgF with an N-terminal EGFP fusion. No ledger evidence supports insertions in any of the three extracellular loops (ECL1 102–117, ECL2 182–196, ECL3 266–270) or the C-terminus (intracellular, 296–343). The sequence length computed from the provided string is 344, one more than the stated 343; all residue lookups used the provided numbered sequence directly and are unaffected by this discrepancy.
